description: This file defines specialized template classes for matrix multiply-accumulate (MMA) operations using BF16 data types, targeting CUDA architectures with tensor cores. It includes different configurations for operand layouts, data types, and pipeline stages, primarily for optimized GEMM kernels in deep learning workloads.

classes.name: DefaultMma
classes.description: Template class for specialized BF16 MMA operations with various configurations, including pipeline stages, operand layouts, and architecture-specific optimizations.

classes.name: DefaultMmaCore
classes.description: Defines core components for MMA operations, including thread mappings and shared memory iterators.

methods.name: DefaultMma
methods.description: Primary template for BF16 MMA specialization, parameterized by data types, layouts, architecture, and operation specifics.

methods.name: DefaultMmaCore
methods.description: Defines core components for MMA, such as thread mappings and tile shapes.
